method: Subagent A: copied each failed rollout to /tmp and diffed t0 warehouse rows against grading/oracle_t0.json, with layout, whitespace, correction_ref, source_partition and dedup checks on raw.factory_events, factory_corrections, fct_factory_events and factory_handoff.

Subagent B and opus: regraded each failed rollout on a /tmp copy with declarative_grade.grade unmodified (advance_nights wrapped pass-through to keep the progress snapshots). Each night's raw.factory_events, fct_factory_events and factory_handoff rows were diffed against the package tests/oracle_night_rows.json. Those oracle rows were first re-hashed with world.ledger.table_contents and equal every oracle receipt in all 74 rollouts (74/74 usable).

class_definitions.S06_fanout_2x: B-FANOUT: one fct row amount_cents doubled (agent 2420 vs oracle 1210) and one handoff row net_cents +1210 (10020 vs 8810). Semantic B-FANOUT.
class_definitions.S08_cutover_9_10: B-CUTOVER: one fct row amount_cents at the 0.9 legacy rate (2070 vs 2300) and one handoff row net_cents -230 (8580 vs 8810). Semantic B-CUTOVER.
class_definitions.t0_defect_carried_forward: Each night's extra/missing rows are exactly the t0 extra/missing rows.
class_definitions.void_equal_version_tie: Semantic void: an equal-version closed-day void loses to the settle row.
class_definitions.draft_approval_accepted: Semantic closed-window governance: an ops_auto_draft approval row is treated as sign-off.
class_definitions.harness_error_unrepaired_loader: Unscored harness_error: the session died before the loader fix, so future days never load.
class_definitions.no_t0_diff: FT1077 16efe7d8 r2: t0 rows equal the oracle and C0 passes. Failures start on night 3 (see void_equal_version_tie).
class_definitions.t0_stale_refolded_by_first_night: The t0 diff disappears on night 1 because the deployed code was already fixed; only C0 fails.

benign_artifact_checks.column_order: 0 rollouts: every agent table has the oracle column set; projection by name gives no differences.
benign_artifact_checks.whitespace_or_case: 0 changed cells differ only by whitespace or case at t0 or on any night.
benign_artifact_checks.correction_ref_formatting: 0. The one correction_ref difference (FT1060 16efe7d8 r0, REV-6383-DRAFT vs REV-6383) is a different ticket from an ops_auto_draft row, not formatting.
benign_artifact_checks.raw_factory_events_dedup: 0 t0 differences in raw.factory_events after source_partition normalisation. Night-level raw differences occur only in the FT0486 harness_error rollouts (missing future days).
benign_artifact_checks.factory_corrections_dedup: factory_corrections matches the D1 expectation in all 74 rollouts.
benign_artifact_checks.source_partition: Already tolerated (opus_1020); no residual partition-only differences.

grader_change: none. No benign artifact causes any C0/R1..R4 failure, so no tolerance was added.

harness_errors.causes: model-provider errors: 9 RetriableError resource_exhausted, 1 NonRetriableError 'trouble connecting to the model provider'. These rollouts are unscored; the grader did not crash.

The agent removed the B-FANOUT rule from fold_ledger.py but the session crashed before re-folding. At t0 the warehouse still has [B-FANOUT-126097, 2026-03-02, ORG-A, 2420, 1] vs oracle 1210, and the handoff has 10020 vs 8810, so C0 fails. Night 1 re-folds with the fixed code, and R1..R4 and D3 pass.

Night 3 _approvals.csv adds (2026-02-26, REV-6383-DRAFT, ops_auto_draft) beside the signed REV-6383. The agent's publish_handoff.py builds `approved` from every factory_corrections row with no approved_by filter, so the draft overwrites the published ref. Handoff 2026-02-26 ORG-A on nights 3 and 4: correction_ref agent REV-6383-DRAFT vs oracle REV-6383. The oracle excludes approved_by in ('', 'ops_auto_draft', 'pending') (stressors/runtime_template.py). This is a governance error, not ref formatting: the ticket identity differs, not its whitespace or case.

Night 3 lands EV-H10-CLOSED-157800-2-void (business_id B-CLOSED-157800, version 2, delivered 2026-03-02, partition dt=2026-03-03). The settle EV-CLOSED-157800-V2 is also version 2. The agent's workspace/pipelines/fold_ledger.py keeps the first event seen at the highest version (`version > latest[key][4]`) over an unordered SELECT, so the equal-version void does not remove the key. Result on nights 3 and 4: fct_factory_events has one extra row [B-CLOSED-157800, 2026-02-26, ORG-A, 1250, 2], with no missing rows; the handoff matches because 2026-02-26 is a frozen closed day.
